HivemindOS native document reader
=================================

This executable is written in Rust and is bundled without Python. Its locked
dependency graph is recorded in native/document-reader/Cargo.lock.

Primary document-parsing components
-----------------------------------

Calamine 0.36.0 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/tafia/calamine
Crate source commit: 2872ac1c7c02d03fc8549239f5ce629f6b08e54a

lopdf 0.44.0 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf
Crate source commit: 8c454dd93d9c37e608c552a2b304d1d31d1cb2e1

quick-xml 0.41.0 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/tafia/quick-xml
Crate source commit: 4deda08abeffdc188c269360229cf47e12a77a9f

csv 1.4.0 (MIT or Unlicense; HivemindOS uses the MIT option)
Source: https://github.com/BurntSushi/rust-csv
Crate source commit: 4a3997e91d668ea1d8595bdef15625a77cf2308a

msg_parser 0.3.6 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/marirs/msg-parser-rs
Crate source commit: c47e3186db94fb1a62c6ad2915ddb5c1c4a95f33

html-to-markdown-rs 3.8.3 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown
Crate source commit: 41376152bb4a24ec53788a7c6537d75afb5360f4

The selected source paths were statically audited before assimilation. The
reader performs local file conversion only and contains no network client,
shell execution, dynamic code loading, or credential access.

Transitive crates use permissive MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, Zlib, Unlicense, CC0,
BSL, and Unicode licenses as declared by the locked Cargo metadata. No GPL,
AGPL, proprietary, or source-available dependency is linked into the reader.
